lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 vertical white lines of varying thickness; spacing is irregular, with narrower intervals in the anterior section and wider gaps in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 4th line from the anterior, splitting toward the ventral midline. A merging pattern is visible at the base of the 7th and 8th line segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 5, 9, and 11 exhibit significant discontinuities, terminating mid-torso. The posterior-most markings consist of isolated circular blobs rather than continuous vertical segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 6 distinct high-contrast white spots located on the lower haunch above the hind leg joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line across the thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes; prominent white patch on the lower throat; distinct white band on the lower forelimb above the hoof.
